Preserve natural exception class and exact message.
Preserve successful outputs and authoritative/reference equality.

Remove strong stale argument references contributed by failed invocation arena frames.
Treat identity metadata transactionally to the extent required by observed known-key mapping and sequential-ID evidence.
Do not reset to a global startup baseline.
Do not blanket-clear the shared arena or erase legitimate outer frames.
Do not clear unrelated caches or decoded memo Maps.
Do not redesign runtime patch ownership ledger or cache-epoch transactions absent new evidence.
Do not refactor away intentionally shared/spaghetti architecture merely to solve this defect.
Do not change public API or successful-call semantics.
